mechanism.slow_loop: compact loop-control state written to the same ledger plus snapshot
mechanism.slow_reentry: next fast cycle can receive bounded ClayGraph memory support from loop_control:episode:<id>
mechanism.controller: same loop_dynamics_controller recurrence function as the integrated spine
mechanism.lesion: loop_dynamics_controller lesion halts the episode as HALT_LESIONED

negative_result_and_fix.finding: Initial first fast cycle used delta=1.0 solely because no predecessor existed; recurrence interpreted this as ABORT_DIVERGING and terminated every episode immediately.
negative_result_and_fix.resolution: Treat the no-predecessor first observation as neutral delta=0.5; divergence now requires observed comparative evidence rather than absence of a baseline.
